Think that you are in the army with your best friend. You will be treated as a soldier by teacher, and you will be supported as a best friend by the same teacher. Your guideline to your future seems to be here.

She is very disciplined and organized about lab sessions but it is not the same for the class hours. I cannot get what topic we are on and I have always missed parts. Also, she can get angry very fast if she doesn't find your question reasonable, because of that I always have chosen the silence in lessons. But if she likes your question, after the lesson she searches about it and sends the articles to find the answer. If only she had one-on-one care with her students. Actually, if you are her favorite student, she cares about you otherwise sorry for you. I was so excited about this course at the beginning of the year, thanks for discouraging me!

First of all, she is a great person when she is talking Turkish and outside of the class. Unfortunately, her teaching techniques and attitude towards us when she is talking English are not that good. Her personality weirdly changes when she is talking another language. Firstly, I got anxious when I want to ask her a question during the classes because she kindly humiliates the question and the person who ask it. She was acting very unstable at the beginning of the semester but later on, she was less unstable. Secondly, she turns the lesson into the private lessons. There are 2 or 3 people that always ask expert questions and she always answers them. She teaches 10-minute classes and answer questions for 40 minutes. At least 60 people's attention diminishes when this happens. This happens in nearly every lesson. Not for 40 minutes, yes but she can't stop those unnecessary questions. Office hours exist for questions like these too. Also, labs are very unnecessary. We did labs and wrote lab reports which we are going to learn in the further semesters. The lab sessions before the labs are the most unnecessary things ever in this semester. The brief information part isn't very brief and it is complicated for everyone. She is trying to teach us a very detailed topic in 1 hour in a very small classroom. The detailed part shouldn't exist either. The first group already knows the details she explains because they did that lab one week earlier, and the first group doesn't even know the lab, how could they understand? In addition, the way she says that if we don't like these lab sessions we shouldn't be in this department isn't true and it harms our self-esteem and it is wrong to say that. Also, she covers topics that are not related to this course at the beginning, and she covers topics in various books so it gets hard to study. We shouldn't have used Campbell in the first place, not we are not that different from students who took MBG110.
I think our instructor was quite good. Of course everyone can be better, but I cannot think of any weak points in particular.
The instructor makes the subject easy to understand and makes sure everyone understands it but she sometimes rebuffs students.

course: Olumsuz tek tarafı dersi haftada yalnızca iki kez görmemiz.

I am sure if Eda hoca covered this course as the previous tutor did, I wouldn't feel like that.
MBG-101 is our first department lecture. It has to include fundamental topics related to biology. The course is interesting for me.
The strongest aspect of this course would be forming the fundamental background. The weakest aspect would be involving topics that are difficult to understand in a short time.

This course wants us to learn a lot of detailed information in such a very short time and it is hard to do that while we are getting two other science courses that are really hard too. Other than that it allows us, undergrads, to decide which field we are interested in most while giving a wide range of information about nearly every topic biology is containing.

There is little to learn if you were a student of the Turkish education system, which sometimes made the lessons boring. Also, the subjects were covered superficially because there are too many of them.
Except the labs and the lab reports there is almost no assignment.

I think that we could have gone a bit deeper into subjects but other than that it is quite satisfactory.

The course felt too elementary for students whose major is MBG. Maybe at the beginning, the chapters we knew could be skipped and we would start learning new things from the start and not wait until nearly the end of the semester.

Group works make this lab work very boring. If you are lucky and you dont afraid that your group mates will hate you, then you can always recommend yourself for transferring the liquid from one tube to another by pipette. Too big class. Less effective work.
